title: A gift card needs a review?
text:
Well, I'll give you a review alright.
This gift card is cheaply made, it looks cheesy, and feels like coming from a used goods store left over pile. On top of all, Amazon didn't offer any discount on their prepaid gift cards, other places always offer a discount on the gift cards they offer.
Next time, readers, go to Costco to get your gift cards, they offer good discounts, you can always wrap your own gifts for a personal touch, your friends and family will appreciate your personal attention you paid to them, love is reciprocal, remember that.
A delivered Amazon cheaply made gift card is not only impersonal, cold and insincere, you'll be repaid by the same down the road. Imagine you are dealing with your business clients using these crappy gift cards, and you are expecting your clients to give you more business next year? Think again !
